purpose: Teach: 夕刻/論外/切り出し/有償/ジョイント/レパートリー/字体/期生

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、夕刻まで店頭に立たれたぞ
lines.en: Your father stood at the shop counter from dawn until closing, especially in those early days.
lines.style: Measured, warm recollection. Slight lift in the voice as memory surfaces. Speaking to Hiroshi with gentle certainty, as one who witnessed it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員への暴言を論外とされた
lines.en: Yes. He would never tolerate anyone speaking harshly to the staff—that was absolute for him.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation with underlying respect. Each phrase lands with the weight of personal conviction. Steady eye contact, remembering clearly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、新事業の話を切り出して説明しいくタイミングが上手かった
lines.en: Your father had a gift for knowing exactly when and how to bring new ideas to the table.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost private observation. A slight catch of admiration in the voice. Speaking as if seeing the memory play out again.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは有償サービスの先駆者だった
lines.en: Yes. He saw the value in paid services long before others did—he was ahead of his time.
lines.style: Reflective acknowledgment, firm but never defensive. Speaking not to convince but to confirm what he has come to understand over years.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、海外企業とのジョイントも実現された
lines.en: Your father even made partnerships with overseas companies—he brought them to life.
lines.style: Warm emphasis on 'brought them to life.' The voice carries pride mixed with the weight of memory. Speaking as if he can still see those early dealings unfold.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは経営者としてレパートリーが広かった
lines.en: Yes. As a businessman, he had a remarkable breadth—he could do so many things.
lines.style: Steady, thoughtful reflection. The words come slowly, as if cataloging the full measure of someone's capacity. No rush—respect in the pacing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、ロゴの字体にもこだわられたぞ
lines.en: Your father even cared about the smallest details—the typeface of the company logo mattered to him.
lines.style: A touch of gentle humor underneath the admiration. Slight emphasis on 'even the smallest'—affectionate recognition of that careful attention.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは創業期生の社員を大切にされた
lines.en: Yes. He treasured the people who came in during those early days—they were precious to him.
lines.style: Quiet finality, like the last piece settling into place. Warm, certain, and deeply felt. This is the truth he has lived with.
